name: H5-X8
prompt:
Image 1 is a motor-axis layout guide only. Replace dots and lines with a complete industrial product and omit all visible guide marks.
Design a coaxial X8 octocopter for everyday carry-along aerial photography. Strict orthographic top view, nose toward the top edge of the image, arms fully unfolded.
Eight motors in a Coaxial X8 layout: four distinct horizontal axes at the corners of a square. Each of the 4 horizontal axes has two rotors stacked vertically; the lower layer may be occluded in this view. Mean opposite-motor (diagonal) span 250 mm; motor-centre width-to-length span ratio W/L 1.00; adjacent arm angles clockwise from the first motor: 90°, 90°, 90°, 90°.
Match the motor centres and frame links in the attached layout image: dots mark motor centres, lines mark frame links. Do not reproduce the dots or lines in the result.
Each motor carries one stationary 2-blade propeller, 5-inch (127 mm) diameter. The two blades point in exactly opposite directions from the hub.
No propeller guards.
Each arm is 15 mm wide and 4 mm thick; seen from above it reads as a 15 mm wide beam.
Each arm grows out of the shell through a smooth seamless blend, with no joint line at the root.
Fuselage design envelope 150 × 55 × 30 mm (length × width × height); this is a size limit, not a shape.
A rounded pod with a continuous curved outline.
A plain top cover with no seams crossing it.
A forward-facing camera sits at the nose and looks horizontally toward the top edge of the image; no lens glass faces the viewer, and nothing camera-like appears at the tail.
The camera sits inside the nose, flush with the shell; from directly overhead only a thin strip of its front window shows at the very front edge of the nose.
Low landing skids with 40 mm ground clearance, tucked beneath the aircraft.
Main shell colour: silver grey (#c7cbd1).
Shell surface finish: fine matte.
Show the complete product on a plain light background as a photorealistic industrial design rendering. Omit guide marks, dimensions and lettering.
negative_prompt: flat schematic, line drawing, collage, text, labels, logo, cropped rotor, disconnected arm, extra rotor, perspective camera, V-shaped propeller, blades at an acute angle, single-blade propeller, missing blade, unequal blades
